_source: dl_purchase as Campaign Cart SDK builds it (NextCommerceCo/campaign-cart 4c00ba06): key names from src/core/analytics/types.ts (UserProperties), user_properties from order.user / order.billing_address and ecommerce from createPurchaseEvent in src/core/analytics/events/ecommerce-events.checkout.ts. customer_phone is always E.164 with '+' (user-data-storage.ts drops anything else). item_category is the campaign name; item_image is the package thumbnail (.webp). Values are illustrative and contain no shopper data.
